ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-brown pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation in the central region extending from the peduncle. High-intensity white contiguous zones are localized on the distal lateral lobes. The left lobe features a wide terminal white patch and a separate interior vertical white stripe. The right lobe features a terminal white patch with high-intensity speckling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly jagged continuous linear boundary with high-frequency serrations; peaks range from 4-15 pixels in amplitude with irregular spacing, most prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory curving upward and outward toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters (rosette-style scarring/barnacles) concentrated heavily on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe and scattered along the trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) visible within the white pigmentation field on the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive brownish-yellow biological staining/biofilm visible across the high-intensity white zones on both lobes; irregular depth of trailing edge serrations suggests accumulated physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, well-defined dark circular spot (approximately 12x12 pixels) located in the lower-central region of the white terminal patch on the left lobe.
